current_evidence: The document page and its PDF (wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Local-Requirement-01-Sept-2026.pdf) both say 'Adopted on 01 September 2026' and the page links to no later version. Cross-checking against the Supporting Documents page and a web search was not possible because the shared WebFetch and WebSearch budgets ran out.

issues.detail: The Householder row says '(none) - national requirements only', but the list applies to all planning applications and several items name or plainly cover householder work: Biodiversity checklist (there is a separate Householder biodiversity checklist), Sustainability Statement, a Flood Risk Assessment in Flood Zones 2/3, a Heritage Statement in conservation areas or listed-building curtilages, an Arboricultural Implications Assessment where protected trees are affected, roof plans for alterations to roof forms, site sections on sloping sites, and a PEA/bat roost assessment for roof, fascia or cladding changes.
issues.evidence: 'Biodiversity checklist required for all applications.'; 'Sustainability Statement Required for all planning applications.'; FRA: 'This includes householder development, small non-residential extensions'

issues.detail: About 27 requirements sit under Full planning only, with the note 'INFERRED: application type not named ... placed under Full planning' (e.g. Sustainability Statement, Biodiversity Checklist, Air Quality, Noise, Lighting, Land Contamination, Transport Assessment, Travel Plan, Nutrient Neutrality). The list is general and applies proportionately to all applications. As a result the Outline and Reserved matters rows say '(none)', although major outline schemes would need the Affordable Housing Statement, SCI, Surface Water Drainage Statement, Archaeological DBA, Nutrient Mitigation checklist, etc.
issues.evidence: 'When Required (proportionate approach is taken as to level of detail in each particular case)'

issues.detail: The Flood Risk Assessment trigger shown is actually the Heritage Statement text ('NFNPA Strategic Flood Risk Assessment Heritage Statement ... Required for all applications affecting designated and non-designated heritage assets...'). The real FRA trigger is all development in Flood Zones 2 and 3 (including householder), plus in Flood Zone 1 sites of 1 ha or more, land with critical drainage problems, land the SFRA shows at increased future risk, and land at risk from other flood sources where a more vulnerable use is introduced.
issues.evidence: 'A site-specific flood risk assessment should be provided for all development in Flood Zones 2 and 3.' ... 'In Flood Zone 1, an assessment should accompany all proposals involving: sites of 1 hectare or more;'

issues.detail: The BNG row's trigger text belongs to two other items (Construction management statement and Design and Access Statement). The source's BNG requirement is: for applications subject to the general biodiversity gain condition, the national minimum information plus a condition assessment of the habitats on site, and a habitat plan with an accurate scale bar and page size.
issues.evidence: 'Condition assessment required to confirm types and state of habitats on site.'

issues.detail: The 'Habitats Regulations Assessment information / SPA mitigation' row is really the Construction management statement (required for all applications within or immediately adjacent to SSSI, Ramsar, SAC or SPA areas). Its trigger is cut off and runs into the Design and Access Statement text. Meanwhile the 'Construction (Environmental) Management Plan' row quotes the construction method statement that is part of the listed-building Heritage Statement, not the Construction management statement.
issues.evidence: 'Construction management statement Required for all applications within or immediately adjacent to SSSI or Ramsar, SAC or SPA areas'

issues.detail: 'Character / Conservation area appraisal reference' (Full planning) quotes the Land Contamination trigger. The list has no such separate requirement: the conservation-area text belongs to the Heritage Statement. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' and 'Photographs / Photomontages' also quote fragments of the listed-building Heritage Statement ('internal and external photographs and a construction method statement'), which are not stand-alone requirements for all Full applications.
issues.evidence: Heritage Statement: 'Required for all applications affecting Listed Buildings including works and buildings within the curtilage of a listed building.'

issues.detail: The 'Arboricultural Impact Assessment / Tree Survey' trigger is cut off and runs into the Archaeological DBA heading ('...NFNPA Website Archaeological Desk-Based Ass'). It also leaves out the separate Tree Survey/AIA trigger: required wherever trees or hedgerows would be lost or affected, directly or indirectly.
issues.evidence: 'Required for all applications where trees or hedgerows are proposed to be lost or would be affected (directly or indirectly) by the development.'

issues.detail: The 'Ecological Survey / Assessment (incl. PEA, protected species)' trigger only repeats the biodiversity checklist line. It misses the two real triggers: ecology surveys for development within, adjacent to or close to designated sites, and a Preliminary Ecological Assessment (including a Potential Bat Roost Assessment) for any demolition or change to roofs, cladding, fascias, soffits, hanging tiles or weather boarding.
issues.evidence: 'Preliminary Ecological Assessment (including Potential Bat Roost Assessment) required for any development involving demolition or changes of a structure or changes to roof and cladding structures including fascias, soffits,'

issues.detail: The Land Contamination trigger leaves out the second trigger: sites within 250 m of a currently licensed or historic landfill site.
issues.evidence: 'Within 250 metres of a currently licensed or historic landfill site.'

issues.detail: Agricultural and Forestry/Estate Worker/Commoner's Dwelling Statement is not captured. Trigger: proposals for agricultural, forestry, estate worker's or commoner's dwellings and all new agricultural buildings, with agreement to pay for independent verification.
issues.evidence: 'Required for proposals for agricultural/ forestry/ estate worker's or commoner's dwellings and all new agricultural buildings.'

issues.detail: Landscape Statement is not captured; only the LVIA sentence was. Trigger: development where existing trees, hedges and other landscape features will be affected.
issues.evidence: 'Required for development where existing trees, hedges and other landscape features will be affected by the proposals'

issues.detail: Two parts of Additional Plans are not captured: existing and proposed site sections with finished floor and site levels (1:50 or 1:100) wherever ground levels change or the site slopes, and a block plan showing site access and the works in relation to adjacent neighbours.
issues.evidence: 'Existing and proposed site sections and finished floor and site levels (1:50 or 1:100) ... in all cases where proposals involve a change in ground levels or is on a sloping site.'

issues.detail: The Variation of condition s73 row says '(none)', although the list (and Grokbot's own tab item) requires extra scalable elevations and floor plans showing the previous proposals superimposed over the current ones for Section 73 applications.
issues.evidence: 'For Section 73 (variation of condition applications), additional, scalable elevations and floor plans clearly showing the previous proposals superimposed over current proposals.'

issues.detail: The Listed building consent row holds only a mislabelled 'Character / Conservation area appraisal reference'. It is missing the Design and Access Statement (expressly required for LBC) and the Heritage Statement for works affecting listed buildings and their curtilage (internal/external photos plus a construction method statement).
issues.evidence: DAS: 'Required for applications for listed building consent.'

issues.detail: The Ventilation/Extraction Statement sits only under 'Change of use - prior approval'. The source applies it to applications for food-preparation uses (restaurants, cafes, takeaways, pubs), i.e. planning applications, and it is absent from Full planning. The Arboricultural assessment under 'Works to trees' is also doubtful, because the list covers planning applications, not tree works applications.
issues.evidence: 'Required for applications for uses involving food preparation – restaurants, cafes, takeaways and pubs'

issues.detail: Several tab items are web-page boilerplate or policy-reference fragments rather than requirements: 'It references relevant local plan policies ... Download PDF ... Contact us for other formats Document Viewer Document types'; the Supporting Documents navigation text ('17 March 2026 PDF Biodiversity Checklist ... Show all documents Show all documents'); 'Local Plan Policies DP2, SP16, SP17 ... Where to look for further assistance NFNPA Website'; 'Environment Act 2021 National Planning Policy Framework Section 15 Biodiversity net gain - GOV.UK ('.
issues.evidence: Tab items under 'Submission rules' and 'Drawing / document standards'

issues.detail: 'Water efficiency / water usage statement' is not a separate requirement. Its trigger is a fragment of the Sustainability Statement content ('...water efficiency; and enabling wildlife and habitats to adapt to climate change').
issues.evidence: Sustainability Statement: 'details of how the proposal is resilient and responsive to the impacts of climate change'

issues.detail: Tab items appear twice, once from the web page and once from the PDF: the scale bar/key dimensions rule, the 'Do not scale ... unless for planning purposes' rule, the habitat plan scale-bar rule and the Nutrient Mitigation item. One policy-driven item also merges the Construction management statement and the DAS and is cut off mid-sentence ('buildings of ').
issues.grok_comment: The "Do not scale" rule, the habitat-plan scale-bar rule and the Nutrient Mitigation item do each appear twice in the generic tab items. The "metric scale bar, key dimensions" rule appears only once; the other item reads "All applications must be in metric and preferably in A3 size".
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. Three items are duplicated, not four.

issues.detail: The reference_row 'Planning page' is the same URL as the validation list document, not the authority's planning or validation landing page (Apply for planning permission > Supporting documents).

summary: Grokbot's link is the current list (adopted 1 September 2026) and the date is right. The extraction is poor: several triggers are cross-wired between neighbouring items (FRA, BNG, HRA, conservation area), the agricultural/commoner's dwelling statement, landscape statement and site-section requirements are missing, and the Householder, Outline, LBC and S73 rows wrongly say no local requirements apply.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
